feedback:
Approved to race as a single-field test. The candidate is iteration 5 (the best raced design, score 160.4) with controller.kd raised from 0.3 to 0.45 and everything else unchanged. It is valid, and it isolates the damping lever that the iteration 5 telemetry pointed to. In iteration 5, max_error stayed at 0.0604 (oval), 0.0623 (s-bend) and 0.0616 (slalom) on every track, so every run still ended off_track. Line_loss_events were 1.3, 2.0 and 1.0, and steering_oscillation was 0.28 on the oval, 0.20 on the s-bend and 0.14 on the slalom. Iteration 4 showed that raising kp to 3.0 overshoots and worsens s-bend line loss, so steering gain is exhausted. The search_right change in iteration 5 left per-track line losses essentially unchanged. The remaining untested lever is kd, which was only tried at 0.1 (iteration 0) and 0.3 (every later iteration). Oscillation has stayed well under the 0.3 level, so 0.45 is a bounded step, not a jump.

What to do depends on the race telemetry. If max_error falls on the oval and slalom (toward about 0.058 m) with line_loss_events at or below 1.3, keep kd 0.45 and treat base_speed as the next lever. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.3 on any track, or max_error rises, revert kd to 0.3 and test a different lever instead. If max_error is unchanged at about 0.06 m with oscillation low, kd is not the binding limit either, so the next test should be base_speed (1.3 to 1.5) only if completion_time is limiting. Otherwise, change one field only, to avoid confounding.
requested_changes: If max_error falls below about 0.058 m on the oval and slalom and steering_oscillation stays below about 0.3: keep kd 0.45 and raise controller.base_speed from 1.3 to 1.5 as the only change, since the oval finish at 1.89 s in iteration 5 shows speed is adequate there.

If steering_oscillation exceeds 0.3 on any track, or max_error rises above the iteration 5 values (0.0604, 0.0623, 0.0616 m): revert controller.kd to 0.3 and test controller.line_loss search_left as the only change, since the line-loss side is still untested.

If max_error stays at about 0.06 m and line_loss_events are unchanged with kd 0.45: keep kd and change one field only (geometry.sensor_size is already at its maximum, so try controller.ki from 0.05 to 0.1 to test whether steady bias contributes to the 0.06 m excursions).
